rubric.meaning: Strict evidence-gate coverage, not prediction accuracy or probability of winning.
rubric.ninety_five_percent_rule: A section reaches 95% only when all five mandatory gates pass; partial gates are reported for transparency.

gates.name: target_form_coverage
gates.evidence: 18/18 target teams have a form snapshot

gates.name: independent_score_crosscheck
gates.evidence: 15/18 primary target teams cross-checked independently; OpenFootball attempt 4/15 scores
gates.blocker: Independent score verification does not cover every target team; the OpenFootball attempt is partial or unavailable for the remaining teams.

gates.name: recent_stats_complete
gates.evidence: 84/90 observations have stats; raw-page audit 90 pages, anomalies 0
gates.blocker: At least one recent team-match observation lacks statistics; raw pages confirm source-level missing fields.

gates.name: npxg_transfer_gate
gates.evidence: Frozen npxG transfer gate passed on WSL

gates.name: provider_robustness
gates.evidence: Independent provider npxG passes its uncertainty gate

gates.name: audited_event_input
gates.evidence: 157628 pressure events audited

gates.name: pressure_predictive_gate
gates.evidence: Pressure feature passed a frozen holdout
gates.blocker: Pressure feature was rejected by its holdout gate.

gates.name: target_tactical_feed
gates.evidence: No target pre-kickoff tactical event feed
gates.blocker: Target tactical event/video evidence is unavailable.

gates.name: inter_analyst_labels
gates.evidence: No independently labelled target tactical sample

gates.name: pre_kickoff_tactical_validation
gates.evidence: No current target tactical feature has a validated holdout
gates.blocker: Current tactical evidence is descriptive only.

gates.name: registered_squads
gates.evidence: 9/9 registered-squad pairs

gates.name: target_starting_xi
gates.evidence: 0/9 official target XIs
gates.blocker: Official target starting XIs are not available for every fixture.

gates.name: recent_lineups_complete
gates.evidence: 86/90 recent observations have lineups

gates.name: current_availability_status
gates.evidence: Registered lists are present but injury/suspension status is unverified

gates.name: player_impact_holdout
gates.evidence: Lineup impact feature passes both holdouts
gates.blocker: Lineup impact feature failed its holdout gates.

gates.name: uefa_metrics
gates.evidence: UEFA locked-period metrics are recorded

gates.name: classwise_calibration
gates.evidence: Classwise calibration is recorded

gates.name: market_incremental_value
gates.evidence: Internal model adds validated value above opening market
gates.blocker: Internal model was rejected as a market addition.

gates.name: timestamped_uefa_odds
gates.evidence: 0 timestamped odds quotes observed across 4 supplied URLs
gates.blocker: Supplied URLs returned no usable timestamped odds quote.

gates.name: current_market_validation
gates.evidence: Current target model-market gate is closed
gates.blocker: The current target model has no validated market edge.

gates.name: chronological_holdouts
gates.evidence: Chronological UEFA and transfer protocols are recorded

gates.name: source_checksums
gates.evidence: Refresh source hashes and lineage checks are recorded

gates.name: multi_league_sample
gates.evidence: 1,678 domestic market-matched fixtures audited

gates.name: untouched_prospective_scoring
gates.evidence: Latest target archive has no final results yet
gates.blocker: A sufficiently sized untouched prospective score is unavailable.

gates.name: publication_timestamps
gates.evidence: Historical source publication times are not captured

decision: No section reaches the 95% evidence threshold.
